memories.content: The board has reviewed the acquisition proposal from PharmaCorp and decided to recommend against it. They will present their recommendation at the September 15 special meeting.

PharmaCorp has made a tender offer to acquire BioGen Therapeutics, with a deadline of September 30. A special shareholder meeting is scheduled for September 15 to vote on the acquisition. The board has announced it recommends against the proposal.
